alfred.description: Carry out a sequence of household chores from a high-level goal and step-by-step instructions in AI2-THOR.
alfred.input: Household instructions and an egocentric view
alfred.assessment: Full task success and fraction of goal conditions met; path-weighted variants are also reported
alfred.first_author_affil: Paul G. Allen School of Computer Sci & Eng, Univ of Washington

calvin.description: Test whether a robot can execute consecutive language instructions without resetting between subtasks.
calvin.input: A sequence of language commands and robot observations
calvin.output: Arm and gripper controls for each step
calvin.assessment: Environment checks each subtask; report success by chain length and mean completed length

behavior-1k.description: Specify everyday activities as initial and goal conditions for agents in simulated household scenes.
behavior-1k.input: An activity specification and simulated observations
behavior-1k.assessment: Check final goal conditions for task success; the paper also reports efficiency measures
behavior-1k.date_note: Public blind CoRL submission, not an environment release.

maniskill2.description: Evaluate rigid- and soft-body manipulation policies on object variations in the SAPIEN simulator.
maniskill2.input: Simulated robot and object observations; task-specific goal
maniskill2.output: Continuous robot controls under the chosen controller
maniskill2.assessment: Task-specific simulator success conditions; aggregate success over evaluation episodes
maniskill2.date_note: Public software release v0.2.0; not necessarily the initial launch.

vima.description: In VIMA-Bench, infer an object-manipulation task from interleaved text and images and carry it out in simulation.
vima.input: Multimodal prompt and current scene views
vima.output: A sequence of pose-parameterized manipulation actions
vima.assessment: Episode success averaged over tasks within each of four generalization levels
vima.date_note: Blind ICLR paper became public. VIMA is the policy and VIMA-Bench is the evaluation suite.

furniturebench.description: Benchmark a robot on multi-stage furniture assembly from different initial part configurations.
furniturebench.input: Camera views and robot state for an assembly task
furniturebench.assessment: Assembly success across trials and number of completed phases for partial progress

libero.description: Learn successive language-conditioned manipulation tasks and test how earlier skills transfer.
libero.input: Language instruction and robot observations across tasks
libero.output: Robot actions in a manipulation episode
libero.assessment: Simulated task success across the learning sequence
libero.first_author_affil: The University of Texas at Austin

robocasa.description: Evaluate a robot on language-specified kitchen activities across layouts, objects and scene styles.
robocasa.input: A kitchen task instruction and robot camera observations
robocasa.output: Arm, gripper and optional mobile-base actions
robocasa.assessment: Task-specific environment checks; report the success rate over trials
robocasa.first_author_affil: The University of Texas at Austin

vlabench.description: Follow natural-language manipulation requests and test whether a policy can complete long-horizon goals.
vlabench.input: An instruction and visual observations from the simulated scene
vlabench.output: Robot actions or an executable skill sequence
vlabench.assessment: Interactive evaluation reports success and a progress score that gives credit for completed stages
vlabench.first_author_affil: School of Computer Science, Fudan University

embodiedbench.description: Turn visual observations into actions for navigation, manipulation and other simulated tasks.
embodiedbench.input: Embodied instruction and visual observations in a simulator
embodiedbench.output: High-level plans or lower-level actions, by environment
embodiedbench.assessment: Task success rate in the simulator

embodied-arena.description: Compare embodied models across multiple established tasks.
embodied-arena.input: Task-specific visual, spatial or language inputs.
embodied-arena.output: An answer, navigation action or plan, depending on the task.
embodied-arena.assessment: Underlying benchmark metrics; the suite exposes separate capability and benchmark views.

roboarena.description: Compare two policies performing the same task in the real world.
roboarena.input: A task instruction and robot observations.
roboarena.output: Robot actions in matched physical trials.
roboarena.assessment: Double-blind pairwise preference judgments are aggregated across evaluators.

ref-robodojo.description: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation of Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
